description.value: The Watershed Grill is a riverside bar and grill in Brackendale, just north of Squamish, celebrated locally for its patio overlooking the river. The kitchen emphasizes local and organic meats alongside seasonal features like tacos, ribs, and pastas, paired with BC craft beers. For cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky corridor, it offers one of the few waterside dining stops between Squamish and Pemberton.

raw_osm.name: The Watershed Grill
raw_osm.wheelchair:description: The parking lot is gravel as well as the pathway up to the very steep ramp onto the patio. The space is quite tight but with the shuffling of a few chairs is passable with a wheelchair.
